receipt schemas, retention and authority ceilings, skill taxonomy, AI-native seam stances, and explicit secondary human advisory stance

organs.purpose: Bind behavior to exact WALDO model/release lineage and expose missing links without allowing model prose to author lineage.
Project stable corpus BOM facts into a bounded machine surface while preserving verification limits.
Bind behavior to exact run plan, corpus, origin, backend, environment, checkpoint state, and output identity.
Resolve which verified model/release/tokenizer identity produced an observation and refuse silent identity drift.
Seal lineage-bound context/request/output digests, verification, dissent, outcome, permission, and closed authority.
Check exact declared training/evaluation overlap and authorship claims; incomplete evidence stays HOLD or UNKNOWN.
Expose behavior-named and legacy WALDO profile contracts without turning corpus selection or weight into a causal-output claim.
Provide an allow-listed, byte-bounded, source-labelled provenance packet to the learned clone without allowing provenance mutation.
Assess typed source/origin claims against the exact packet while preserving causal, legal, and reproducibility ceilings.
Precommit pack, target, context, metrics, comparison dimensions, answer-key boundary, limits, permission, and closed authority before outputs.
Bind profile, context, claim assessment, and precommitted protocol into the final run-backed behavior receipt.
Validate fresh, attributed, zero-retention receipts from all thirteen Workshop Sensorium contracts without claiming capture or inheriting permission.
Keep KNOWLEDGE, INSTRUCTION, and ADAPTER inventory roles separate; compare exact current/backup manifests and emit review-only recovery candidates.
Preserve primary AI-native evidence seams and explicit secondary human-native meaning advice without averaging, imitation, or authority transfer.
Join exact provenance, explicitly required sensory receipts, skill continuity, and dual discovery to one answering identity and subject.
Bind the situated envelope and each component digest into the existing gated behavior chain; held situated evidence cannot become a passing outcome.
Compare identical sealed evaluations across exact releases while preserving behavior, verification, dissent, authority, and non-comparable dimensions separately.
Carry unresolved objections across releases until explicitly resolved or superseded by linked evidence.
Compare original and reconstructed runs without conflating artifact equality with behavioral similarity.
Trace corrections, disputes, or removals through dependent runs, models, releases, and behavior records as review impact.
Design controlled comparisons for source-to-behavior hypotheses without claiming corpus membership proves causality.
Audit exact/near-exact reproduction under declared protocols without converting matches into legal or causal conclusions.
Preserve license assertions, disputes, policy filters, identity verification, and absence of legal conclusion as separate states.
Separate generic WALDO-useful work from AXM-specific identity before any human-authorized upstream proposal.
